title: Purportedly AI-Generated False Citations in Arizona Probate Appeal Reportedly Led to Sanctions Against Self-Represented Appellant

behaviors.text: Self-represented appellant a person reportedly used purported AI tools to prepare an opening brief in a probate dispute involving his late mother's estate.
The court affirmed the appointment of his sister, a person, as personal representative, ordering Kotchka to pay her attorney fees attributable to addressing the false citations.
